audit.whatIsWrong: Xerath's W is called "Eye of Destiny" in spikes[0].text and in the early breakdown text; the real ability is "Eye of Destruction".
audit.why: packet.suspectNames flagged this exact string; champ-data/_kits/xerath.json confirms the real slot-W name is Eye of Destruction.
audit.corrected: Both occurrences fixed to Eye of Destruction.

audit.whatIsWrong: All 7 phases[].side values are the literal placeholder "Skill" even though content win[] already has every row as Xerath — Galio is behind the whole lane per the 47.04% win rate.
audit.why: The rendered chart should show Xerath winning every stage, not the placeholder word.
audit.corrected: All 7 phases[].side -> Xerath, why text and ratings rewritten to reflect a losing matchup throughout.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content already correctly identifies that Shocking Orb (E) is Xerath's only CC and that holding it denies your Flash-E/R engage, plus that Rite of the Arcane (R) sieges from beyond your R range.
audit.why: Verified against the kit: E is the only hardCC flag on Xerath, R has 5000 range vs Galio's R max 5500 (but Xerath's is instant-cast poke, not a commit, unlike Galio's telegraphed R).
audit.corrected: No content change; added Shocking Orb's real cooldown (13/12.5/12/11.5/11) and the R-channel-cancel fact to the full-layer Key Ability Interactions report entry.

edits.before: Xerath's level-2 is brutal: Q Arcanopulse plus W Eye of Destiny slow-zone let him poke your ADC off the wave from a screen away, and your melee kit has zero range answer. Your E Justice Punch can't reach him without Flash, so you're forced to soak with W Shield of Durand and give up trades.
edits.after: Xerath's level-2 is brutal: Q Arcanopulse plus W Eye of Destruction slow-zone let him poke your ADC off the wave from a screen away, and your melee kit has zero range answer. Your E Justice Punch can't reach him without Flash, so you're forced to soak with W Shield of Durand and give up trades.

edits.before: Xerath dominates every early level: Q Arcanopulse and the W Eye of Destiny slow-zone out-range your whole kit, and with no gap-closer online you and your ADC just eat poke walking to CS. Hold W Shield of Durand for his biggest hits, hug the wave, and accept you can't trade back until you have Flash up for an all-in.
edits.after: Xerath dominates every early level: Q Arcanopulse and the W Eye of Destruction slow-zone out-range your whole kit, and with no gap-closer online you and your ADC just eat poke walking to CS. Hold W Shield of Durand for his biggest hits, hug the wave, and accept you can't trade back until you have Flash up for an all-in.

edits.before: Q the pair — the tornado tick chips duos that stand in formation.
edits.after: His Q Arcanopulse out-ranges your entire kit and controls the wave from the start.

edits.before: W charge threat begins: the taunt governs their engage plans already.
edits.after: Q-plus-W slow-zone chunks your duo while your E can't reach him without Flash.

edits.before: Full kit: E-W the committed trade and the magic shield refunds their poke.
edits.after: His artillery poke keeps you soaking — you still have no way to trade back.

edits.before: Zone with taunt threat and shield the margins — AP duos pay double rent.
edits.after: His range plus a held Shocking Orb stun keeps you pinned and unable to engage.

edits.before: Hero's Entrance online — every roam your duo survives, you end.
edits.after: Rite of the Arcane sieges and a held Shocking Orb still out-pressures your Flash-E.

edits.before: First item: the taunt rotation chunks and the MR makes mage supports cry.
edits.after: A completed haste item lowers his Q cooldown for chain-poke below your all-in threshold.

edits.before: Late Galio is the anti-dive: taunt their engage off your carry and R the map's emergencies.
edits.after: He sieges from outside R range and one Shocking Orb cancels your only engage tool.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: His E Shocking Orb is a single-target stun — bait it with a ward or a minion before you commit Flash-E.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: His 750-1000 range poke chunks anyone who walks up without vision — force fog, not an open lane.

edits.before: Track Xerath’s Shocking Orb (Stun): His only CC — dodge the orb and the artillery never converts. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Track Xerath's Shocking Orb (13s CD at rank 1) — his only CC. His R Rite of the Arcane is also a channel any knockup or taunt cancels outright.

notes: Real error confirmed and fixed: "Eye of Destiny" (Xerath W) is fabricated — the real name is Eye of Destruction (matches suspectNames flag). Level chart's phases[].side held the literal placeholder "Skill" on all 7 rows although content win[] correctly had Xerath winning every stage (47.04% WR over 389 games); side/rating/why were corrected to match without touching win[] (no-op avoided). Content spikes/wants/whys were already well-grounded and specific to Xerath's kit; only the two Eye-of-Destiny typos needed fixing there.
